name: bench-num
description: bench-num is a community-contributed dataset that evaluates models on numeric and quantitative reasoning tasks. It contains problems requiring arithmetic, number manipulation, and basic quantitative reasoning, presented as a mix of multiple-choice and open-ended questions. The benchmark measures a model's ability to compute, compare, and reason about numerical information under diverse prompt styles.
reputation: A small community dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited adoption outside niche numeric-reasoning experiments.
